Scope: All six benchmark problems, D=20, all 30 seeds, 40 actual search stages; dimension selected for a common-dimension view, no outcome filter
CVTransformation: absolute value of selected raw CV prediction, matching search; truth unchanged
StageAggregation: RMSE over 10 new evaluation points per run/stage, then mean and sample SD across 30 runs
PhaseAggregation: Per-run RMSE over all 100 (early/late) or 400 (all) points, then mean and sample SD across 30 runs
ObjectiveScales: Original response units, separate curves for each objective; no cross-problem magnitude comparison
